unit_of_work: One accepted pull request addressing four original linked issue reports; this is not four separately authored contributions.

pull_request.title: fix(mavlink): recover parameter and mission protocol transactions

behavior.problem: Rejected existing-parameter writes could omit the current-value acknowledgement; some mission protocol errors left active transfers or prematurely ended recoverable downloads.
changes: Send the current value after unsupported-type, mismatched-type or read-only rejection of a write to an existing parameter.
Clear active mission transfer state after a matching error acknowledgement or wrong-type item during GETLIST upload.
Retain the expected transfer sequence on unexpected but in-range mission download requests.
behavior.scope: 18 inserted production lines in two MAVLink source files. No broad refactor or independent authored regression test was added to the merged tree.

author_reported_native_replay.scope: Disarmed native protocol replay: parameter responses, mission contents after cancellation/replacement, INT/legacy download recovery; process exited cleanly.
author_reported_native_replay.verification_boundary: This acceptance capture read the submitted test claim and evidence link; it did not rerun the replay or independently reopen the attached ZIP.

coverage_boundary.meaning: A successful CI/coverage check is not evidence that the project coverage run executed the inserted protocol branches. Separate native replay is the reported targeted behavior evidence.

backport_decision.author: julianoes
backport_decision.summary: Does not consider a v1.18 backport necessary because the bug fix is noncritical and the behavior appears longstanding.

counting_note: One accepted contribution addressing four original reports; no distinct-defect tally or financial-value claim.
